svg.title: Curate, Then Pick the Format
svg.desc: Messy sign-up emails are first grouped, ordered and de-duplicated, then the same information is shown three ways: a one-line inline answer to read once, a rota artifact the team keeps editing, and CSV rows for the volunteer system.
svg.text: Organise the material first; the next step decides the format.
By role, then availability; duplicates merged;
